introduction.heading: DX Interiors brings homeowners, designers, and suppliers together in one intelligent design space.

intro_video.heading: Your Virtual Design Studio
intro_video.content: DX Interiors blends intelligent visualisation with curated sourcing, enabling you to select real products, apply colors and textures, and experience your interior design unfold in real-time 3D.

design_your_space.heading: DESIGN YOUR SPACE YOUR WAY WITH DX INTERIORS

list_content_1.heading: Instant Design Validation
list_content_1.content: Bring your vision to life instantly, simply upload a photo or pick a template, then drag and drop photo-realistic furniture and decor to see new ideas unfold.

list_content_2.heading: Real-time Material Visualisation
list_content_2.content: Experience materials with absolute authenticity. Browse curated finishes from our suppliers and see their accurate product details.

list_content_3.heading: Immersive Supplier Showroom
list_content_3.content: Elevate your product catalog into interactive 2D environments, enabling designers and homeowners to engage with your products as they envision their ideal spaces.

list_content_4.heading: Guided Path to Purchase
list_content_4.content: Seamlessly move from idea to decision as users collect products, craft mood boards, and complete selections within an intuitive platform.

design_your_space.last_content: DX Interiors empowers homeowners to elegantly design their spaces using authentic supplier products, envision furniture and finishes within your rooms for making confident choices.
design_your_space.note: For Inquiries, Please Contact us.

cta.heading: FINDING THE MODULE THAT FITS YOUR AMBITION
cta.content: We'll help you map your goals, uncover priorities, and choose the right DXLIVING solution for your project.
